One thing that is causing issues with all gathering professions are the bots. I actually camped in an area and watched several bots run a route. Then they will farm out an area then spawn into another layer. Rinse and repeat.

The bots are deployed based on what they are specifically farming.

I am not going to get into how bots negatively effect player experience and economy. Many players get exasperated and frustrated and wind up quitting as crafting etc is a big part of the game.

Gaming is at a point where bots and their associated accounts can easily be identified. Even right down to in game accounting AI that can easily identify these activities including gold selling/buying.

I dont know the motivation as to why this is allowed to continue. Nor do I want to openly speculate.
